scope: 通用广告/不公平行为 + 小家电（受管制商品 Safety Mark、电气安全）+ 食品接触 + 计量 + 价格展示（GST）+ 隐私与 DNC/营销
review_policy: decision_level=rule_level 表示可在‘法条原文 + 页面原文’同时成立时给出规则级判断；substantiation 表示只能判‘需要证明’；human_review 表示需人工/律师复核。review_required=true 的条目必须人工复核后才能进入报告结论。

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act 2003 消费者保护（公平交易）法 2003
rules.requirement: 供应商在消费交易中不得作出任何行为或陈述、也不得遗漏，以致消费者可能被合理误导或欺骗；判断看整体印象与合理性，不只看单个词。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面原文与上下文、广告投放时间、消费者可能理解的方式；若涉及事实性矛盾，附规格书/检测报告。
rules.penalty_or_note: CPFTA 主要是民事救济：消费者可起诉（s.6）或到小额索偿庭；CCCS 可向法院申请声明/禁令（s.9）。不公平行为本身不是刑事罪。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: It is an unfair practice for a supplier, in relation to a consumer transaction— ... (a) to do or say anything, or omit to do or say anything, if as a result a consumer might reasonably be deceived or misled;
rules.notes: 新加坡没有类似中国广告法的绝对化用语清单；‘best/no.1’是否构成问题取决于是否可证实、是否误导。

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act 2003 消费者保护（公平交易）法 2003
rules.requirement: 不得作出虚假的声称（false claim）；认证、奖项、销量排名、功效、环保等声称必须有依据。
rules.evidence_needed: 证书/奖项主办方与年份、销量数据来源与统计口径、检测报告（方法、样本、实验室资质）。
rules.penalty_or_note: 民事救济（s.6/s.9）；不是刑事罚则。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (b) to make a false claim;

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act 2003 消费者保护（公平交易）法 2003
rules.requirement: 不得表示商品或服务拥有其实际没有的赞助、批准、性能特征、配件、成分、质量、用途或好处。
rules.evidence_needed: 认证/批准文件、背书授权、性能测试报告、配件清单。
rules.penalty_or_note: 民事救济；CCCS 可申请禁令。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 1. Representing that goods or services have sponsorship, approval, performance characteristics, accessories, ingredients, components, qualities, uses or benefits that they do not have.
rules.notes: Safety Mark 是新加坡受管制商品的强制标志；把 Safety Mark 与 SIRIM/CE 混写是常见问题。

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act 2003 消费者保护（公平交易）法 2003
rules.requirement: 不得表示商品或服务具有其实际没有的标准、质量、等级、款式、型号、原产地、重量、体积、长度、容量或制造方法。
rules.evidence_needed: 规格书、材质证明、容量/重量实测、原产地证明、检测报告。
rules.penalty_or_note: 民事救济（s.6/s.9）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 4. Representing that goods or services are of a particular standard, quality, grade, style, model, origin, weight, volume, length, capacity or method of manufacture (as the case may be) if they are not.

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act 2003 消费者保护（公平交易）法 2003
rules.requirement: 不得把非全新、已变质、被改装、翻新或回收的商品表示为新的或未使用过的。
rules.evidence_needed: 采购/入库记录、商品状态说明、翻新记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 民事救济。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 5. Representing that goods are new or unused if they are not or if they have deteriorated or been altered, reconditioned or reclaimed.

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act 2003 消费者保护（公平交易）法 2003
rules.requirement: 不得表示商品/服务可得、因特定原因可得、以特定价格/数量/时间可得，而供应商知道或应知并非如此——除非该表示清楚说明了限制条件。
rules.evidence_needed: 库存记录、促销起止时间、价格适用条件；页面是否在 claim 旁清楚写明限制。
rules.penalty_or_note: 民事救济。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 7. Representing that goods or services are available or are available for a particular reason, for a particular price, in particular quantities or at a particular time if the supplier knows or can reasonably be expected to know it is not so, unless the representation clearly states any limitation.
rules.notes: ‘While stocks last’ 如果没有说明数量或期间，可能不构成‘清楚说明限制’。

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act 2003 消费者保护（公平交易）法 2003
rules.requirement: 不得表示存在价格利益或优势，而该利益或优势实际不存在（如虚构原价、虚假折扣）。
rules.evidence_needed: 促销前后实际售价记录、原价来源、同渠道比较价格（含日期）。
rules.penalty_or_note: 民事救济。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 9. Representing that a price benefit or advantage exists respecting goods or services where the price benefit or advantage does not exist.

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act 2003 消费者保护（公平交易）法 2003
rules.requirement: 不得在供应商品/服务时提供赠品、奖品或其他免费物品，而供应商知道或应知该物品不会提供、或不会按承诺提供。
rules.evidence_needed: 赠品库存与发放记录、赠品条款、活动前后主商品价格。
rules.penalty_or_note: 民事救济。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 19. Offering gifts, prizes or other free items in connection with the supply of goods or services if the supplier knows or ought to know that the items will not be provided or provided as offered.

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act 2003 消费者保护（公平交易）法 2003
rules.requirement: 不得表示商品/服务只在特定期间以折扣价供应，而供应商知道或应知该商品/服务在显著更长的期间仍会以该价格供应。
rules.evidence_needed: 促销起止记录、活动后售价与持续时间。
rules.penalty_or_note: 民事救济。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 20. Representing that goods or services are available at a discounted price for a stated period of time if the supplier knows or ought to know that the goods or services will continue to be so available for a substantially longer period.

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act 2003 消费者保护（公平交易）法 2003
rules.requirement: 以社论、纪录片、科学报告等客观形式呈现、但实质是为销售商品/服务所作的表示，必须明确标注其为广告或促销。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面是否标注 ‘advertisement/promotion’、内容是否为付费/自营、发布位置与格式。
rules.penalty_or_note: 民事救济。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 16. Making a representation that appears in an objective form such as an editorial, documentary or scientific report when the representation is primarily made to sell goods or services, unless the representation states that it is an advertisement or a promotion.

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Trade Descriptions and Safety Requirements) Act 1975 消费者保护（商品说明与安全要求）法 1975
rules.requirement: 在贸易或业务中，不得对商品施加虚假商品说明，也不得供应带有虚假商品说明的商品；‘虚假’包括因说明中包含或遗漏的内容而在实质方面虚假或可能误导。
rules.evidence_needed: 商品标签/详情页原文、规格书、供应商授权链、原产地证明。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 s.4 属犯罪；无特定罚则时适用 s.15：最高 S$10,000 或监禁 2 年或两者兼施。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 4. Subject to the provisions of this Act, any person who in the course of a trade or business— (a) applies a false trade description to any goods; or (b) supplies any goods to which a false trade description is applied, shall be guilty of an offence.
rules.notes: CPTDSRA 是刑事条款；CPFTA 是民事不公平行为条款，两者可并行。

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Trade Descriptions and Safety Requirements) Act 1975 消费者保护（商品说明与安全要求）法 1975
rules.requirement: 若商品被表示符合某人规定/认可的标准、或暗示获得某人批准，而该人或该标准并不存在，则该表示被视为虚假商品说明。
rules.evidence_needed: 标准编号与发布机构、证书/批准文件、检测报告；核对标准是否真实存在并适用于该产品。
rules.penalty_or_note: 按 s.4 虚假商品说明处罚；s.15 最高 S$10,000/2 年。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 5. For the purposes of this Part— ... (b) a false indication, or anything likely to be taken as an indication which would be false, that any goods comply with a standard specified or recognised by any person or implied by the approval of any person is deemed to be a false trade description, if there is no such person or no standard as specified, recognised or implied.

rules.law_name: Goods and Services Tax (General) Regulations 消费税（一般）条例
rules.requirement: 已注册消费税的商家在展示、刊登广告、发布或报价时，标出的价格必须已包含 GST（按现行税率）；对公众的标价不得以「未含 GST」的金额为主价，除非依 reg.78 取得 Comptroller 的书面豁免。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面价格文本与截图、商品页与结算页最终价格、商家的 GST 注册号与注册状态、是否持有 reg.78 豁免。
rules.penalty_or_note: IRAS 官方指引列明不遵守价格展示要求可被处最高 S$5,000 罚款（指引非条例原文）；报告只写「标价需含 GST / 需更正」，不写具体罚款。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 77.—(1) Where any taxable person displays, advertises, publishes or quotes in any manner the price of any supply of goods or services the taxable person makes or intends to make, such price must include the tax that is chargeable on the supply under the Act unless the Comptroller approves otherwise under regulation 78.
rules.notes: 只约束 GST 注册商家；reg.77(3) 对仅向应税人（B2B）且非公开分发的报价有例外。跨境低价值货物（S$400 以下）自 2023-01-01 起由 OVR 制度处理，标价是否含 GST 取决于商家是否注册 OVR，本规则不展开。

rules.law_name: Goods and Services Tax (General) Regulations 消费税（一般）条例
rules.requirement: 若同时展示含税价与不含税价，含税价的显著程度必须不低于不含税价（同字号、同位置、同视觉强度）。把不含税价放大、含税价塞进小字，即不符合 reg.77(2)。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面截图（两处价格的相对字号、位置、颜色）、CSS/字号信息、报价单或宣传物料。
rules.penalty_or_note: 同 reg.77；IRAS 指引列明可处最高 S$5,000 罚款（指引非条例原文）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (2) Where a taxable person displays, advertises, publishes or quotes, in relation to any supply of goods or services the taxable person makes or intends to make, both of the following prices: ... then the taxable person must, in the display, advertisement, publication or quote, give the price mentioned in sub‑paragraph (a) the same prominence as, or greater prominence than, the price mentioned in sub‑paragraph (b).
rules.notes: 对跨境电商最常见的场景：落地页用「US$xx」吸引，结算页才加 GST 与运费。运费另计属 Layer 3，本条只看含税/不含税的呈现。

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Safety Requirements) Regulations (Cap. 53, Rg 1) 消费者保护（安全要求）条例
rules.requirement: 受管制商品（controlled goods）在附表一指定日期后，未注册为 registered controlled goods、未符合安全要求并贴上 Safety Mark，不得在贸易/业务中供应或为供应而广告。
rules.evidence_needed: Safety Mark 照片与 8 位认证编号、CPSO 注册记录、 Registered Supplier 名称、证书/测试报告。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 reg.4(1) 属 s.11(2) 罪行；罚则适用 CPTDSRA s.15：最高 S$10,000 或监禁 2 年或两者兼施。CPSO 可要求召回。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 4.—(1) No person shall, in the course of any trade or business, supply or advertise for the purpose of supply any controlled goods after the effective date specified in the First Schedule unless— (a) such controlled goods are registered controlled goods conforming to the safety requirements specified by the Safety Authority for those goods; and (b) such controlled goods have affixed to them the Safety Mark in accordance with Part III.
rules.notes: reg.4(1) 明文包含 ‘advertise for the purpose of supply’，与马来西亚 reg.97 类似。是否属于 controlled goods 要逐项对附表一（33 类）。

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Safety Requirements) Regulations (Cap. 53, Rg 1) 消费者保护（安全要求）条例
rules.requirement: 进口商或制造商若打算在新加坡供应或为供应而广告受管制商品，必须向 Safety Authority 申请注册为 Registered Supplier，并注册其打算供应/广告的受管制商品。
rules.evidence_needed: Registered Supplier 注册号、CPSO 注册记录、进口商/制造商与卖家的关系。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 reg.5(1) 最高 S$2,000 或监禁 12 个月或两者兼施（reg.5(2)）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 5.—(1) Any importer or manufacturer in Singapore who intends, in the course of any trade or business, to supply or advertise for supply any controlled goods in Singapore shall apply to the Safety Authority— (a) to be registered as a Registered Supplier; and (b) to register any controlled goods which the importer or manufacturer intends to supply or advertise for supply in Singapore.

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Safety Requirements) Regulations (Cap. 53, Rg 1) 消费者保护（安全要求）条例
rules.requirement: 高风险/中风险受管制商品的注册申请，必须由 Registered Supplier 提交符合性证书（certificate of conformity）；低风险商品则提交供应商符合性声明（supplier’s declaration）。
rules.evidence_needed: CAB (Certification) 出具的 CoC、CAB (Testing) 或认可实验室的测试报告、对应型号与标准。
rules.penalty_or_note: 未按 reg.7 提交文件会影响注册；虚假文件可能触及其他法律。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 7.—(1) Subject to paragraph (5), an application for registration of any high-risk controlled goods or medium-risk controlled goods must be made by a Registered Supplier in such form as the Safety Authority may require, and must be accompanied by— (a) a certificate of conformity in respect of the controlled goods;
rules.notes: 风险等级由 Safety Authority 在官网分类；同一品类不同型号可能不同。

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Safety Requirements) Regulations (Cap. 53, Rg 1) 消费者保护（安全要求）条例
rules.requirement: 只有 Registered Supplier 才能在其注册且注册未被暂停/撤销的受管制商品上贴 Safety Mark，并须按 reg.14 的方式张贴。
rules.evidence_needed: Safety Mark 的 8 位认证编号、注册记录、贴标位置与形式是否符合 CPSO 指引。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 reg.13(1) 最高 S$2,000 或监禁 12 个月或两者兼施（reg.13(4)）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 13.—(1) Subject to paragraph (2), no person shall affix the Safety Mark on any goods unless— (a) he is a Registered Supplier; ... (b) he affixes the Safety Mark on controlled goods registered by him with the Safety Authority, and the registration of such controlled goods is not deemed to be suspended or withdrawn under regulation 24; and (c) he affixes the Safety Mark in accordance with regulation 14.

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Safety Requirements) Regulations (Cap. 53, Rg 1) 消费者保护（安全要求）条例
rules.requirement: 供应未注册/未贴 Safety Mark 的受管制商品，CPSO 可要求召回并向用户告知潜在危险；不执行召回属犯罪，最高 S$2,000 或监禁 12 个月或两者兼施。
rules.evidence_needed: CPSO 召回通知、召回执行记录、用户告知记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 不执行召回：S$2,000 / 12 个月（上限）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (3) Any person who fails or neglects to effect a recall of the controlled goods required by the Safety Authority under paragraph (2)(a) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $2,000 or to imprisonment for a term not exceeding 12 months or to both.

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Safety Requirements) Regulations (Cap. 53, Rg 1) 消费者保护（安全要求）条例
rules.requirement: 附表一列明 33 类受管制商品，包括液体加热器具（电水壶、airpot、热水机，容量≤10L）、厨房机器（搅拌机/绞肉机）、电饭煲等；这些品类适用 reg.4/5/7/13。
rules.evidence_needed: 产品品类与附表一逐项比对、额定电压 ≤250 Vac、容量等参数。
rules.penalty_or_note: 适用 reg.4 的罚则（最高 S$10,000/2 年）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: kettles, airpots and hot water dispensers, which are electrical appliances intended for household use to heat liquids for consumption that have a rated capacity not exceeding 10 litres, with rated voltage of not more than 250 Vac.
rules.notes: 附表一还包含电熨斗、微波炉、风扇、吸尘器、洗衣机等；完整清单需按最新版本核对。

rules.law_name: Food Regulations 食品条例（Sale of Food Act 第 283 章）
rules.requirement: 任何拟用于食品储存、制备或烹饪的器具、容器或器皿，不得可能向食物析出铅、锑、砷、镉或其他有毒物质。页面宣称 food grade／无铅／不含 BPA／食品级不锈钢时，需要有材质说明与迁移量检测报告支撑；仅凭「食品级」字样无法自证。
rules.evidence_needed: 材质与涂层说明（304/316 不锈钢、陶瓷釉、硅胶）、食品接触符合性声明、第三方迁移检测报告（铅/镉/砷/锑，方法如 ISO 6486、FDA CPG 7117.07、EU 1935/2004 + 10/2011）、供应商与批次。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 Food Regulations 依 reg.261：首次定罪最高 S$1,000，再犯最高 S$2,000。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (2) No person shall import, sell, consign or deliver, use or permit to be used any appliance, container or vessel that is intended for use in the storage, preparation or cooking of food, and is either capable of imparting lead, antimony, arsenic, cadmium or any other toxic substance to any food stored, prepared or cooked in it.
rules.notes: 本条是「效果型」义务：不要求商家主观知道会析出，只看是否「可能」析出。报告只能写「需提供检测/符合性证明」，不能写成结论性指控。空气炸锅、电水壶、搅拌机、不粘锅、硅胶铲均适用。

rules.law_name: Food Regulations 食品条例（Sale of Food Act 第 283 章）
rules.requirement: 陶瓷食品器具（杯、马克杯、碗、盘、壶）须满足 reg.37(3) 的铅析出上限：平盘（内深≤25mm）3.0 µg/ml、小型空心器皿（<1.1L，不含杯）2.0、大型空心器皿（≥1.1L，不含壶）1.0、杯与马克杯 0.5、壶 0.5（每 6 件中任一件的最大值）。超标即不得进口、销售、交付或使用。
rules.evidence_needed: 供应商的铅/镉迁移检测报告（ISO 6486-1/2 或 FDA CPG 7117.07）、釉料说明、批次与抽检记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 同 reg.261：首次最高 S$1,000，再犯最高 S$2,000。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (3) Nothing in paragraph (2) shall prohibit the import, sale, consignment, delivery or use of any ceramic food ware where — ... (d) the maximum amount of lead in any one of six units examined is not more than 0.5 mcg of lead per ml of leaching solution in the case of cups and mugs; and (e) the maximum amount of lead in any one of six units examined is not more than 0.5 mcg of lead per ml of leaching solution in the case of pitchers.
rules.notes: reg.37(3) 是 reg.37(2) 的「安全港」：满足限值即不视为违反 (2)。页面常见「handmade ceramic / lead-free glaze」在没有检测报告时属需证明项。

rules.law_name: Food Regulations 食品条例（Sale of Food Act 第 283 章）
rules.requirement: 以奖品、赠品、广告赠送或慈善赠送形式给出的食品器具（food appliance），视同由赠送人「为销售而展示」，同样须符合食品条例（含 reg.37 的食品接触要求）。「买锅送硅胶铲」中的赠品也要有材质与符合性证据。
rules.evidence_needed: 赠品清单与材质说明、赠品的食品接触检测/符合性声明、活动规则页面。
rules.penalty_or_note: 同 reg.261：首次最高 S$1,000，再犯最高 S$2,000。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (2) Where any food which is intended for human consumption or any food appliance is offered as a prize or reward or given away for the purposes of advertisement, or in the course of any trade or business, these Regulations shall apply in relation to that food or food appliance, as if it were, or had been, exposed for sale by the person offering it or giving it away.
rules.notes: 赠品常被当成「非卖品」而跳过合规；本条把赠品拉回同一套要求。页面只写「free gift」而未说明赠品内容时，报告写「需向商家核实赠品品类与材质」。

rules.law_name: Weights and Measures Act 1975 度量衡法 1975
rules.requirement: 在包装、价目表、广告或其他宣传中展示商品时，不得只用非公制单位；非公制单位只能作为公制单位的附加标注，且其数字与字号不得大于对应的公制数值。只写「6.5 qt」「12 inch」而不给升/厘米，即不符合 s.18(1)(d)。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面/包装上的单位写法截图、规格表、说明书与包装实物照片。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (d) in the course of or for the purposes of any trade or business, uses, whether on any package, or in any price list or advertisement or otherwise, any unit of a weight or measure other than a weight or measure of the metric system, in advertising, displaying, or exposing goods for sale, ... (2) Nothing in subsection (1)(d) applies to the use by any person of any unit of a weight or measure which is not a unit of a weight or measure of the metric system on any goods displayed or exposed for sale by retail or on the package of any such goods or on both if — (a) that unit is additional to a unit of a weight or measure of the metric system; and (b) that unit, the figures in which that unit and the numerical value of that unit are marked no larger than those of that metric weight or measure.
rules.notes: 对进口美式规格（qt、inch、lbs）最实用的一条。s.18(1)(d) 由 Act 30/2005 修订，2006-01-01 生效；括注「oz」也可能是重量盎司，匹配时需上下文。

rules.law_name: Weights and Measures Act 1975 度量衡法 1975
rules.requirement: 包装或标签上标示了数量（净含量、件数、容量）的商品，实际数量不得少于标示；只要不足即属犯罪，不要求证明故意。页面写「净重 2.5 kg」而实测不足，即落入 s.19(3)。
rules.evidence_needed: 同批次多点抽样实测记录（电子秤/量杯，含日期与照片）、包装标示照片、进货单据与批次号。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (3) Any person who sells or offers or exposes for sale, or has in the person’s possession for sale, by weight, measure or number, any goods enclosed in a package that states the quantity of the goods or that has a label attached to it stating the quantity of the goods shall be guilty of an offence if the weight, measure or number of the goods in the package is less than that stated on the package or label.
rules.notes: 页面抓取只能记录「标示值」；是否 short weight 必须实测，报告只能写「需抽检核实」，不能据页面推断。s.19(5) 规定包装符合法定条件时推定数量与标示相符（法定公差），故单件轻微不足不必然是罪。

rules.law_name: Weights and Measures Act 1975 度量衡法 1975
rules.requirement: 在销售、展示或告知数量时，不得对商品数量作虚假陈述（口头或其他方式），也不得作出足以误导买方对数量的行为。典型：把整机重量当净重、把毛重当容量、把 4.5L 标成 5L、把「适合 6 人」当作容量表述。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面规格与实际测量的对照表、检测报告、同类同型号的官方规格书。
rules.penalty_or_note: s.19(2) 属 s.35(1)：最高 S$5,000 或监禁 3 个月或两者兼施。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (2) Subject to the provisions of this Part, any person who — (a) on or in connection with the sale or purchase of any goods; (b) in exposing or offering any goods for sale; (c) in purporting to make known to the buyer of any goods the quantity of any goods sold; or (d) in offering to purchase any goods, makes any misrepresentation either by word of mouth or otherwise as to the quantity of the goods, or does any other act calculated to mislead a person buying or selling the goods as to the quantity of the goods, shall be guilty of an offence.
rules.notes: 与 SG-MET-02 的分工：(2) 管「说错」，(3) 管「装少」。页面同时存在标注矛盾（如标题 5L、规格表 4.5L）时，先按 (2) 记录为需核实项。

rules.law_name: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 个人数据保护法 2012
rules.requirement: 组织必须在收集个人数据之前（或在使用/披露新目的之前）告知个人收集、使用或披露的目的；并应个人要求提供能回答相关问题的业务联系人信息。
rules.evidence_needed: 隐私通知/收集时的告知、目的说明、业务联系人、第三方披露说明。
rules.penalty_or_note: PDPA 主要通过专员指示与财务罚款执行：最高 S$1,000,000 或年营业额 10%（s.48J）；另有私人诉讼（s.48O）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 20.—(1) For the purposes of sections 14(1)(a) and 18(b), an organisation must inform the individual of— ... (a) the purposes for the collection, use or disclosure of the personal data (as the case may be) on or before collecting the personal data; (b) any other purpose of the use or disclosure of the personal data of which the individual has not been informed under paragraph (a), before the use or disclosure of the personal data for that purpose; and (c) on request by the individual, the business contact information of a person who is able to answer on behalf of the organisation the individual’s questions about the collection, use or disclosure of the personal data.
rules.notes: 新加坡法没有一条叫 ‘privacy policy’ 的强制条文；义务是收集前的目的告知。把‘没有隐私政策’直接判为不合规是过度推断。

rules.law_name: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 个人数据保护法 2012
rules.requirement: 组织必须指定一名或多名负责人确保遵守 PDPA，并向公众提供至少一名被指定/授权人员的业务联系信息。
rules.evidence_needed: DPO 姓名/职务/邮箱/电话是否在隐私页面或联系页面公开、内部任命记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 未遵守可能构成违反 PDPA；专员可发出指示并施加财务罚款（s.48J）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (3) An organisation must designate one or more individuals to be responsible for ensuring that the organisation complies with this Act. ... (5) An organisation must make available to the public the business contact information of at least one of the individuals designated under subsection (3) or delegated under subsection (4).

rules.law_name: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 个人数据保护法 2012
rules.requirement: 组织不得在未取得个人同意（或法定例外）的情况下收集、使用或披露个人数据；同意必须是自愿、知情且针对特定目的。
rules.evidence_needed: 同意机制截图（勾选框/双重 opt-in）、同意记录、退出机制、收集目的说明。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 Part 4 可被财务罚款（s.48J），最高 S$1,000,000 或年营业额 10%。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 13. An organisation must not, on or after 2 July 2014, collect, use or disclose personal data about an individual unless— (a) the individual gives, or is deemed to have given, his or her consent under this Act to the collection, use or disclosure, as the case may be; or (b) the collection, use or disclosure (as the case may be) without the individual’s consent is required or authorised under this Act or any other written law.
rules.notes: ‘By signing up you agree’ 是否构成有效同意取决于告知是否充分、是否有选择；语境判断。

rules.law_name: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 个人数据保护法 2012
rules.requirement: 组织必须制定并实施遵守 PDPA 所需的政策与做法，建立接收和回应投诉的流程，并在被要求时提供政策与投诉流程的信息。
rules.evidence_needed: 隐私/数据保护政策、投诉渠道、政策更新记录、员工告知记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 未遵守可被专员指示/财务罚款。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 12. An organisation must— (a) develop and implement policies and practices that are necessary for the organisation to meet the obligations of the organisation under this Act; ... (b) develop a process to receive and respond to complaints that may arise with respect to the application of this Act; ... (d) make information available on request about— (i) the policies and practices mentioned in paragraph (a); and (ii) the complaint process mentioned in paragraph (b).

rules.law_name: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 个人数据保护法 2012
rules.requirement: 向新加坡电话号码发送「指定信息」（营销性质的语音电话、短信、MMS）前，必须向 PDPC 的 DNC 登记册查询，并在发送时持有「该号码未登记」的有效确认（查询结果有法定有效期）。无法出示查询记录，即无法证明合规。
rules.evidence_needed: DNC 查询记录（含查询日期、有效期、查询账号）、发送名单与发送时间、代运营/短信服务商合同与操作记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 Part 9 可由专员发出整改指示（s.48I(1)(b)）；故意或过失违反可被要求支付财务罚款：非个人最高 S$1,000,000，个人最高 S$200,000（s.48J(1)(b)(i)、(4)）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 43.—(1) Subject to section 48(2), a person must not send a specified message addressed to a Singapore telephone number unless the person has, at the time the person sends the specified message, valid confirmation that the Singapore telephone number is not listed in the relevant register.
rules.notes: 这是流程义务，页面本身看不出来；只能作为「需向商家索取 DNC 查询记录」的核查项。s.37 的「指定信息」看目的（广告/促销），不看形式。

rules.law_name: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 个人数据保护法 2012
rules.requirement: 营销短信/多媒体信息必须清楚、准确标明发送者（或授权发送者）的身份，给出收件人可随时联系该发送者的方式，且该联系方式在发送后至少 30 天内仍然有效。只写「回复 T 退订」而无商家名称或可回拨号码，不满足 s.44。
rules.evidence_needed: 短信/彩信原文与截图、发送号码、回拨与回复测试记录、发送清单。
rules.penalty_or_note: 同 s.48I / s.48J：可被指示整改，故意或过失可被财务罚款（非个人最高 S$1,000,000，个人最高 S$200,000）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 44. Subject to section 48(2), a person must not send a specified message addressed to a Singapore telephone number unless — (a) the specified message includes clear and accurate information identifying the individual or organisation that sent or authorised the sending of the specified message; (b) the specified message includes clear and accurate information about how the recipient can readily contact that individual or organisation; ... (d) the information included in the specified message in compliance with this section is reasonably likely to be valid for at least 30 days after the message is sent.
rules.notes: 只适用于「指定信息」；纯事务性通知（订单、发货）不属于。页面上的「订阅短信优惠」入口是这条的高频触发点。

rules.law_name: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 个人数据保护法 2012
rules.requirement: 不得把「同意接收营销信息」作为供货条件，也不得要求超出提供该商品/服务所合理需要的同意；以此取得的同意无效。典型：结账页预勾选营销同意、不同意就不让下单。
rules.evidence_needed: 结账/注册流程截图（勾选框默认状态、是否必选）、T&C 相关条款、取消订阅路径。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (1) A person must not, as a condition for supplying goods, services, land, interest or opportunity, require a subscriber or user of a Singapore telephone number to give consent for the sending of a specified message to that Singapore telephone number or any other Singapore telephone number beyond what is reasonable to provide the goods, services, land, interest or opportunity to that subscriber or user, and any consent given in such circumstance is not validly given.
rules.notes: 判断「是否超出合理需要」需结合交易语境，属 human_review。与 s.13（同意须自愿）互为补充。

rules.law_name: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 个人数据保护法 2012
rules.requirement: 收件人可以随时通知撤回对接收营销信息的同意，商家不得禁止或设置不合理障碍；撤回后须停止向该号码发送。页面/短信必须提供可用的撤回渠道。
rules.evidence_needed: 退订入口截图与可用性测试、撤回请求的处理记录、撤回后的发送日志。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 47.—(1) On giving notice, a subscriber or user of a Singapore telephone number may at any time withdraw any consent given to a person for the sending of any specified message to that Singapore telephone number. (2) A person must not prohibit a subscriber or user of a Singapore telephone number from withdrawing the subscriber’s or user’s consent to the sending of a specified message to that Singapore telephone number, but this section does not affect any legal
rules.notes: 只覆盖「指定信息」的同意撤回；个人数据的撤回同意另见 PDPA 的 consent withdrawal 义务（本库未单列）。

rules.law_name: Spam Control Act 2007 垃圾信息控制法 2007
rules.requirement: 批量发送的未经请求商业电子讯息（邮件、短信、MMS）必须：提供一个可用的退订渠道（邮箱/网址/电话/传真/地址）并附退订说明；该渠道在发送后至少 30 天内有效；收到退订后 10 个工作日内不得再发。
rules.evidence_needed: 邮件/短信原文（含页脚）、退订链接或号码的可用性测试、退订后的发送记录、批量发送名单规模。
rules.penalty_or_note: SCA 以民事救济为主：受害方可依 s.13 提起民事诉讼，s.14 可申请禁令与损害赔偿；本版未见刑事罚则。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 11. Any person who sends, causes to be sent or authorises the sending of unsolicited commercial electronic messages in bulk must comply with the requirements in the Second Schedule. ... 2.—(1) Subject to sub-paragraphs (2) and (3), every unsolicited commercial electronic message must contain — (a) an email address, an Internet location address, a telephone number, a fax number or a postal address that the recipient may use to submit an unsubscribe request; and (b) a statement to the effect that the recipient may use the email address, Internet location address, telephone number, fax number or postal address (as the case may be) provided in the unsolicited commercial electronic message to submit an unsubscribe request, or a statement to similar effect. ... (7) Where a recipient submits an unsubscribe request using the facility provided in accordance with this paragraph, no further unsolicited commercial electronic messages may be sent after the expiry of 10 business days after the day on which the unsubscribe request is submitted.
rules.notes: 「批量」门槛见 s.6（同一 24 小时内发送 100 封以上电子邮件等）；一对一的客户跟进不落入。页脚只有「© 公司名」而无退订方式，是常见缺口。

rules.law_name: Spam Control Act 2007 垃圾信息控制法 2007
rules.requirement: 未经请求的商业电子邮件，须在主题栏（无主题则在正文开头）以「<ADV> 」标明这是广告，且主题与头信息不得虚假或误导。注意：发给即时通讯账号（如 WhatsApp）的信息不适用本项标注要求（para 3(3)）。
rules.evidence_needed: 邮件主题原文与截图、头信息（发件域、路由）、发送记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 同 s.13/s.14 民事救济；无刑事罚则。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 3.—(1) Subject to sub-paragraph (3), every unsolicited commercial electronic message must contain — ... (b) the letters “<ADV>” with a space before the title in the subject field, or if there is no subject field, in the words first appearing in the message, to clearly identify that the message is an advertisement; ... (3) Sub-paragraph (1) does not apply to any unsolicited commercial electronic message that is sent to an instant messaging account.
rules.notes: para 3(3) 的即时通讯豁免由 Act 40/2020 于 2021-02-01 加入；WhatsApp 营销仍受 PDPA DNC 与 s.44 约束，只是不需要 <ADV> 前缀。
